mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.dispatch_token AS dispatchToken, ts.enqueue_seq AS enqueueSeq, t.queue_id AS queueId, t.priority AS priority FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id WHERE ts.status = 'SCHEDULING' AND ts.dispatch_token IS NOT NULL AND ts.updated_at < now() - (#{minutes} * interval '1 minute') AND t.deleted = false ORDER BY ts.updated_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.dispatch_token AS dispatchToken, ts.mutex_group AS mutexGroup, n.id AS nodeId, t.queue_id AS queueId, t.priority AS priority, ts.enqueue_seq AS enqueueSeq FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id JOIN workflow_step ws ON ws.id = ts.step_id LEFT JOIN executor_node n ON n.ip = ts.machine_ip AND n.cluster_id = ts.cluster_id WHERE ts.status = 'RUNNING' AND ws.timeout_seconds IS NOT NULL AND ts.start_time + make_interval(secs => ws.timeout_seconds) < now() AND t.deleted = false ORDER BY ts.start_time LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE executor_node SET heartbeat_miss_count = heartbeat_miss_count + 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE enabled = true AND deleted = false AND online_status = 'ONLINE' AND last_heartbeat_at < now() - interval '15 seconds'

UPDATE executor_node SET online_status = 'OFFLINE', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE enabled = true AND deleted = false AND online_status = 'ONLINE' AND last_heartbeat_at < now() - interval '45 seconds'
mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.step_instance_id AS stepInstanceId, ts.dispatch_token AS dispatchToken, ts.mutex_group AS mutexGroup, n.id AS nodeId, t.queue_id AS queueId FROM task_step ts JOIN task t ON t.id = ts.task_id JOIN executor_node n ON n.ip = ts.machine_ip AND n.cluster_id = ts.cluster_id WHERE ts.status = 'RUNNING' AND n.online_status = 'OFFLINE' AND n.enabled = true AND n.deleted = false AND n.last_heartbeat_at < now() - (#{windowSeconds} * interval '1 second') AND t.deleted = false ORDER BY ts.start_time LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_step SET status = #{toStatus}, fail_reason_code = #{failReasonCode}, fail_reason = '执行节点失联（恢复窗口已过）', end_time = now(), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
